description: Assam has partnered with Google to enhance state administration through AI, focusing on governance frameworks, ethical guidelines, and workforce upski
body_lead: Guwahati: The Assam govt on Tuesday, in the presence of information technology minister Keshab Mahanta, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Google to improve efficiency, speed and transparency in state administration through the use of artificial intelligence (AI). Focussing on creating robust frameworks for AI governance, the MoU includes ethical guidelines to ensure transparency and equity, as well as capacity-building programmes, to enhance the AI skills of the stateâs workforce.
